login.title: Sign in to Spotify
login.note: Choose Agree on the Spotify page that opens in your browser
login.denied: Choose Agree on the Spotify page

method.standardNote: Sign in to Spotify in the browser; Folia plays the songs itself. The equalizer, Automix and the effects that move with the music all work.
method.soloistNote: Sign in to Spotify in the browser; Spotify's own Soloist program plays the songs. For accounts that get no audio key. Soloist is downloaded separately, and its API key is made with a Premium account.

setup.title: Spotify Soloist setup
setup.note: Soloist is Spotify's own player, a program on this computer that sends its sound to the system output itself; Folia steers it and follows its position for the lyrics. Folia's equalizer, Automix and the effects that move with the music do not reach its sound.
setup.noteStandard: Folia plays Spotify's songs itself now. If this account gets no audio key and songs fail with "cannot play here", you can switch to Spotify's own Soloist.

noKey.title: This account gets no audio key from Spotify
noKey.note: Spotify gives this account no audio key, so Folia's own way cannot play its songs (common for accounts made since late 2024). You can play through Spotify's own Soloist instead: download the Soloist program, make an API key with a Premium account, and pick the device once in a Spotify app. Playlists, lyrics and search are not affected.

mode.noKeyNote: Folia's own way cannot play this account's songs.

program.todo: Download Soloist for this computer from Spotify's page, unpack it and pick the soloist program inside (soloist.exe on Windows). Folia does not include it.
program.expiring: Version {{version}} stops running in {{days}} days ({{expires}}). Each build runs for 90 days: download the new one, unpack it and pick it again.
program.unknown: Version {{version}}. This build's date cannot be read, so when it stops running is not known. Each build runs for 90 days; then Soloist refuses to start.
program.clock: This build is dated later than this computer's clock: the clock may be wrong, and the days left cannot be counted.
program.expired: This build expired ({{expires}}) and Soloist will not start. Download the new one, unpack it and pick it again.
program.missing: The program picked before is not there any more; it may have been moved or deleted. Pick it again.
program.invalid: The file picked is not a Soloist program that runs. Pick another.

key.label: Soloist API key
key.todo: Open Spotify's developer dashboard with a Premium account, make a Soloist API key and enter it below. It is kept on this computer, sealed with the system keychain. Soloist takes the key only on its command line, so other users of this computer can see it in the process list while it runs.
key.saved: The key is saved, sealed. Soloist takes the key only on its command line, so other users of this computer can see it in the process list while it runs.
key.locked: The system keychain cannot be opened now, so the saved key cannot be read. Unlock it, then press Reconnect.
key.noKeychain: This computer has no system keychain to seal the key with (basic_text on Linux, for one), so the key is not saved.
key.unreadable: The saved key cannot be read (another system account or keychain, perhaps). Enter it again.

pair.waiting: Do the two steps above first.
pair.todo: In a Spotify app on the same network (phone or computer), open the device list and pick "Folia". Once is enough: it signs in by itself afterwards.
pair.startFailed: Soloist did not start. Check the program and the key, then press Reconnect.

message.pickedExpired: That build has expired and was not used. Download the new one.
message.pickedInvalid: That file is not a Soloist program that runs and was not used.
message.keychain: The system keychain is not available; the key was not saved.
message.keyShape: That is not a key: it should be one run of characters without spaces.
message.failed: That did not work; the runtime log says why.
